summary: AmBase Corp filed an 8-K on October 13, 2026, reporting a letter agreement with Chairman/President/CEO Richard A. Bianco, who advanced an additional $1,500,000 under the existing RAB 2026 Litigation Funding Agreement (initial commitment $6,000,000) to fund working capital and litigation expenses tied to the 111 West 57th Property. The registrant is the issuer receiving affiliate financing. No price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or ownership change is stated. The going-concern qualification and exploration of strategic alternatives remain the operative disclosures. Watch for further affiliate funding, dilution risk, and the underlying litigation outcome.
